preconditions.description: The number of words in the scroll is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The length of each word is at least 1 and the sum of lengths of all words does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: output == 0 if no valid original scroll exists
postconditions.description: If no valid original scroll can be formed, the output is 0.

invariants.expression: all words are strings of lowercase English letters
invariants.description: Each word consists of lowercase English letters only.

invariants.expression: words are in lexicographically non-decreasing order
invariants.description: The words are in lexicographically non-decreasing order, meaning each word is not lexicographically smaller than the previous word.
